walls.note: Molenpad side. Every panorama (2024, 2025) sees only its east end past Keizersgracht 454: channelled ground storey with blind windows, tall blind first-storey windows, the frieze and the modillion cornice carried round, quoins, a tiled hipped roof with a chimney. Six blind axes on the front's rhythm; the four west of the view are inferred.

walls.note: Yard wall on the Molenpad (2025 frontal, 2021): white gate piers with dark caps, iron gates, a wrought-iron arch with a lantern over the west gate; the low yard building behind. The 3DBAG puts a 6.6 m wall on the street line; the gate is drawn on it.

Yard side (2018 crops): the low white yard building with iron railings on its walls and gate lanterns, and the main block's plain west face with two window axes and the cornice carried round. Drawn as the 3DBAG shell in the render colour; the main block's west face (ring edge 5) gets its two axes and cornice.
